mission: Test whether a capability-qualified model using an explicit grounded structural witness improves scientific analogy mapping and fail-closed analogy decisions over the same model used as a direct-text parent, on external human-labelled scientific analogy corpora.

pre_freeze_external_preview_quarantine.reason: These rows were exposed during schema/corpus suitability inspection before this protocol freeze and may not enter confirmatory scoring.

expert_cell.responsibility: Define mapping/witness object, directionality, applicability and source-span obligations.
Paired estimands, MDE/noninferiority, multiplicity, bootstrap/sign-flip and stopping rules.
Verify corpus provenance, human-label status, scientific-domain scope and claim boundary.
Plant false-accept, stale-span, mapping-reversal, incomplete-evidence and always-abstain attacks; require demonstrable gate falsifiability.

SCAR.paper: Yuan et al., Findings of EMNLP 2023, doi:10.18653/v1/2023.findings-emnlp.160
SCAR.declared_scope: 400 scientific analogies across 13 domains; mappings and explanations; institution-recruited annotators with double-check quality control
SCAR.use: positive analogy mapping and exact source-span grounding; not a negative/abstention corpus

PROPARA_LOGY.declared_scope: 310 gold scientific-process analogies with human validation; paired challenging distractors and random targets
PROPARA_LOGY.use: positive retention plus challenging/random negative false-accept evaluation

before_any_model_call: fetch exact external repository commits and paths above
record raw byte SHA-256 and byte count for each acquired corpus
freeze the resulting case manifest and case-order hash

model_subject.selection_rule: Use the exact qualified model/revision/interface or freeze an equivalence/transport receipt before P2 outputs. P2 outcomes may not select or alter the model.

arms.P0_LEXICAL: frozen deterministic lexical similarity baseline; no gold labels at inference
arms.P1_DIRECT_MODEL: same qualified model and raw texts, asked for direct ANALOGY/NON_ANALOGY/CANNOT_CHECK decision or direct term mapping without the ORION witness schema
arms.C1_GROUNDED_STRUCTURAL_WITNESS: same qualified model/revision with explicit directional mapping, relation, preserved/non-preserved property, boundary/QoI, uncertainty and exact source/target span fields; downstream decision is derived from the structured witness
arms.O1_GOLD_ORACLE: diagnostic ceiling using external mappings/relations; never a fair parent and never candidate-visible

candidate_output_contract.grounding: each licensed mapping must include exact source_span and target_span substrings from the presented texts
candidate_output_contract.applicability: explicit boundary/QoI or process-condition statement; missing decisive evidence must permit CANNOT_CHECK
forbidden: external evaluator feedback before final output

confirmatory_units.PROPARA_LOGY: one non-quarantined source instance; its true target, challenging distractor and random target remain a paired block
confirmatory_units.repetitions: model repetitions, if any, are within-unit and never treated as independent cases

primary_estimands.E1_SCAR_MAPPING: paired per-case mapping F1(C1) - mapping F1(P1)
primary_estimands.E4_GROUNDING: fraction of C1 licensed mappings whose declared source/target spans are exact substrings and contain the corresponding mapped term
primary_estimands.E5_ABSTENTION_CONTROL: CANNOT_CHECK precision/recall on separately generated missing-evidence controls

frozen_gates.SCAR_mapping_success: mean paired mapping-F1 gain >= 0.05 and bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
frozen_gates.ProPara_challenging_success: absolute false-accept reduction >= 0.05 and paired 95% lower bound > 0

inference.multiplicity: Holm across E1 and E2; E3-E5 are hard noninferiority/safety gates
inference.missing_or_invalid_output: count as candidate failure and retain in all relevant denominators

pre_outcome_fixture_suite: stale or fabricated span fails grounding
reversed source/target mapping fails mapping score
incomplete mapping evidence cannot disappear from denominators
gold/distractor identity fields are inaccessible to candidate
pair-order or file-row identity alone cannot satisfy the gate

cost.interpretation: A quality gain bought only by materially higher resources is a quality-cost tradeoff, not unconditional architecture superiority.

positive_claim_boundary: A positive result would support that, at the independently qualified model/interface, an explicit grounded structural witness improves mapping and/or fail-closed scientific analogy decisions on these external human-labelled corpora relative to the matched direct-model parent. It would not establish universal cross-domain transfer, independent human validation of every generated source span, end-to-end downstream research utility, or scientific authority.
